messages:
Sarah (AM): Heads-up — CardinalPay pilot is blocked by identity + egress asks from CISO. They won't start data sync until SSO + SCIM confirmed and a POC egress cap is agreed. Need internal unblock and quick decision on egress credit.
Miguel (SE): Reproduced the SSO failure on our side. Browser shows 'Invalid ACS URL' when SP initiates SAML. Config they sent has a trailing slash mismatch.
Priya (Security): CISO also wants completed security questionnaire (we have 80% answered) and an IP allowlist for the POC. They explicitly requested no public egress during the pilot if possible.
Leo (RevOps): Pricing ask: they want a hard cap for egress at $2,000 for the pilot month and a 20% discount on overage. Can we offer a one-off credit or commit? Need finance sign-off.
Emma (PM): Product note: SCIM full provisioning is not GA yet — we can ship a scoped SCIM endpoint in ~2 weeks, or enable manual sync + short-lived admin API tokens as a stopgap.
Miguel (SE): Quick workaround that unblocks user provisioning: we can run a one-time CSV import and return scoped API keys with expiry. Also sending SAML config fix: set ACS to `https://cardinalpay.prod/saml/consume` (no trailing slash) and disable `ForceAuthn` for their IdP.
Sarah (AM): @Tom (CEO) — can we get an exec signoff to offer POC egress credit and to greenlight the temporary manual-provisioning workaround? Customer is asking for commitment by EOD tomorrow to keep the pilot timeline.
Tom (CEO): I can greenlight a limited egress credit up to $2k for the pilot if Security signs off on the IP allowlist and RevOps confirms billing guardrails. Put the terms in a one-paragraph email draft and cc me.
Priya (Security): I can sign off on IP allowlist if we get the customer's peering CIDRs and run a quick risk review. Also require that audit logs for the pilot are retained for 30 days.
Leo (RevOps): I'll draft the egress credit terms: 100% covered up to $2k, 50% covered on next $3k, with a cap and automatic disable if it goes over. Need finance to confirm but I can own monitoring.
Miguel (SE): Pasted test command for SAML tester: `curl -I -X POST -d "SAMLResponse=@/tmp/resp.b64" https://redwood.example/_saml/acs` — shows 200 after config fix.
Emma (PM): I'll prioritize the scoped SCIM work in the next sprint and create a small runbook for manual CSV imports.
Sarah (AM): Action items: Miguel to push SAML guidance to CardinalPay; Priya to request peering CIDRs and run risk review; Leo to finalize credit terms and monitoring; Emma to prepare runbook; Tom to sign off on final email.
ops-bot: Deployment alert — feature/SCIM-scope scheduled deploy tomorrow 03:00 UTC. No downtime expected.
Sarah (AM): Thanks team — I'll coordinate external comms and send the exec email draft shortly. Will update this thread after customer call at 16:00 PT. :thumbsup:
